entries.notes: Baseline for Navigator 2.0 filtering and Navigator 10 register map.
Prepared API release with optional local web supplement and default-safe Navigator 10 firmware register polling.
Beta integration line consumes the optional web supplement, faster model detection and reduced Navigator 10 web delay.
Adds stable web supplement metadata/helpers, optional firmware probing and Navigator 10 WebSocket reconnect hardening for the next integration pin.
Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: address 1072 is no longer treated as a Navigator 10 indicator, preventing Illegal Data Address errors during first setup.
Resolves heating-circuit address overlaps, hardens web-clients against session leaks and race conditions, disables double retry, adds quiet_pymodbus_logging() helper.
Adds post-batch validation for corrupt enum values and supports 8-room zone modules.
Release vehicle for zone-room count fixes and room-mode batch read recovery reported in HASS issues #68 and #69.
Stability and performance patch: TimeoutError retry handling, skip permanently failed registers in read_register(), optimized read_batch() grouping, and defensive Navigator 10 websocket close.

Optional web client optimization and hardening: Nav10 request error tuples built once at import, single auth-frame parse, Nav2 close() no longer leaks session state on failure, plus expanded web client test coverage.
Maintenance release with refreshed release metadata after 0.6.4.
Adds a stable query for registers rejected with Modbus Illegal Data Address, enabling consumers to maintain their own polling skip-list.
Security and reliability patch for web host validation, safe Modbus writes, authentication handling, transient failure recovery, LF normalization, and reduced Navigator 2.0 startup traffic.

Hardens Navigator 10/2.0/Pro batch reads: never spans unrequested address gaps, validates recovery reads, quarantines suspect registers, preserves documented sentinel values, and bounds humidity to 0-100%.
Ignores documented -1.0 flow-temperature sentinels for unconfigured Navigator heating-circuit slots during model detection.
Restores the documented Navigator register map and humidity float decoding, and reconnects after pymodbus no-response errors.
Declares unavailable sentinels verified on Navigator 10 hardware so normal optional-register values do not trigger corrupt-batch recovery and repeated warnings.
Hardens transport failure propagation, recognizes the verified cascade-unavailable sentinel, supports consumer-driven batch quarantine, and adds explicitly acknowledged custom-register writes.
Stabilizes Navigator 2.0 local web login for direct IPv4/IPv6 hosts by allowing IP-literal cookies on API-owned aiohttp sessions.

Detects non-contiguous heating circuits (e.g. A+D) via active-mode cross-check and exposes heating circuits B-G in the Navigator 10 web client. Source: two-device Navigator 10 ALM capture (2026-07-16).

Marks zone-module room relay registers (zm{z}_room{r}_relay) as binary status bits so the Home Assistant integration can expose them as binary_sensor entities with on/off instead of numeric 0/1 sensors. Closes Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#128.

Adds neutral binary register semantics metadata. The Home Assistant integration validates this API through its api-main CI path, while its released manifest pin and integration version remain unchanged until a separate tested addon release.

Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: register power_limit_hp (4108) returning a sentinel value (e.g. -1.0 / 0.0) on IDM Terra SWM controllers is no longer misclassified as Navigator 10. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#44.
Fixes Navigator 10 model detection when power_limit_hp (4108) is set to sentinel/default -1.0 by probing address 4001 (booster_fault), and adds set_model_info() helper.

Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: a booster_fault (4001) response of the declared 'not configured' sentinel (255 / 0xFFFF) is no longer misclassified as Navigator 10; only a non-sentinel 4001 value proves the Navigator 10 booster block, consistent with the 4108 plausibility check. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#170.

Adds a strict tertiary Navigator 10 indicator: the Navigator-10-only registers power_consumption_hp (4122) and thermal_power_flow_sensor (4126) must BOTH respond. Closes the gap from 0.8.5 where a real Navigator 10 in standby without a configured booster (4108 unplausible, 4001 sentinel) was misdetected as Navigator 2.0. Verified live on a Navigator 10 controller (firmware NAV10_20.24-880-g265e09c4a). Navigator 2.0 / IDM Terra SWM stay Navigator 2.0 because they reject 4122/4126 with Modbus Exception 2. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#170.

Sentinel authority: adds RegisterDef.effective_sentinel_values and datatype-based default sentinels (FLOAT -1.0, UCHAR 255, UINT16 65535, INT16 -1/-32768), plus explicit pump-status opt-outs. Makes the integration's former numeric heuristic data-driven and device-specific (SENT-01). No address/type/write-path changes.

First 0.9.x stable. Bundles 0.8.6 (Navigator 10 standby detection via 4122/4126) and 0.8.7 (sentinel authority). Additive and backward-compatible only. Verified live on Navigator 10 (firmware NAV10_20.24-880-g265e09c4a); Navigator 2.0 / Terra SWM covered by the unit-test matrix.

Adds a public IdmModbusClient.eeprom_write_interval property (getter/setter) so the integration can expose the EEPROM write cooldown as an advanced option (default 60s, lowerable at the user's own risk). No address/type/write-path changes.

First stable 1.0.0. Introduces the public IdmModbusTransport protocol and injectable transport so consumers can route raw Modbus I/O without subclassing. Default direct-Pymodbus behaviour is observably identical to 0.9.x.

Patch release: _connect_internal now raises ConnectionException instead of AttributeError when the transport is explicitly None, and write_registers uses the shared check_transport_response mapping so exception code 2 is classified as IllegalAddressError like reads.

Web client mapping expansion: adds heating-circuit room temperature sensors B61-B67 (room_temperature_HK_A through G) to SENSOR_NAME_MAP and WEB_VALUE_DESCRIPTIONS. Verified live on a Navigator 10 ALM 6-15 with heating circuits A and D (B64 = 21.8 Â°C).

Maintenance release with no library changes: only the CodeQL security workflow was updated (github/codeql-action init and analyze pinned to 4.37.7 / CodeQL bundle 2.26.3). Runtime behaviour and the public import surface are byte-identical to 1.0.2, so integration pins can move without retesting.

Breaking: library-owned exception hierarchy (IdmModbusError and subclasses), pymodbus moved to the optional [pymodbus] extra, IdmDeviceError.exception_code added. First beta of the 2.0.0 line, pinned by integration 0.16.0-beta.1 as idm-heatpump-api[web]==2.0.0b1; 0.15.1 stays pinned to 1.0.3. The API version is PEP 440 (2.0.0b1) and the integration version is SemVer (0.16.0-beta.1) on purpose: pip resolves the former, HACS reads the latter.

Stable release of the 2.0 line after validation of 2.0.0b1 with integration 0.16.0-beta.1. No register-map, encoding, write-safety or wire-protocol changes from the beta: the release fixed the workflow smoke check that stopped either release workflow from shipping a 2.x wheel, and pointed the contract tests back at the integration's main. First pinned by integration 0.16.0-rc.1 as idm-heatpump-api[web]==2.0.0.

Adds the Navigator 1.0/1.7 protocol family as a read-only model: official 1.x register table (input block 1000-1088, status words 1500-1524), Illegal-Data-Address signature detection, and a family-wide write block.
Renames the Navigator 1.7 compressor statuses to the shared family's compressor_status_N names so consumers reuse translations and binary metadata.
Fixes inaccessible NAV10 sections and login detection.
Adds optional register step metadata without changing wire encoding or write validation.
Adds the Navigator 10 home/detail read (demand reason incl. PV, energy-flow power) as a new public web API; no changes to existing wire encoding, register map or write validation.

Complete official Navigator 1.0/1.7 RW holding block (ma_de_812049 Rev.1): operating modes, per-circuit setpoints, heating curves, limits, signed bivalence points, solar mode, freshwater DHW setpoint. Register map only; no changes to wire encoding or write validation.
Declares the documented MIN/MAX ranges on the Navigator 1.x status words so consumers can reject the uninitialized-memory reads of Rev.0-era firmware (idm-heatpump-hass#364).
Per-register read outcomes (get_register_outcomes): last value even when rejected, raw wire words, and rejection reason, for self-sufficient diagnostics exports (idm-heatpump-hass#364).
Released with the 0.19.0 stable pin. Heats the heating-curve controller precision to 0.05 on Navigator 1.x (issue #364 capture); no wire changes.

Navigator 1.x FC01/FC05 coil block (c3000-c3003 of ma_de_812049 Rev.1) plus the optional IdmCoilTransportExtension on the transport boundary; get_register resolves model-map registers before the legacy CORE short-circuit (idm-heatpump-hass#319).
Read-only error-code database (get_error_code_info / ErrorCodeInfo): 2005 vendor codes with German texts, packaged as package data; no changes to registers, wire encoding or write validation.

WebSocket read expansion: read_status_overview / read_freshwater_overview with parsers and dataclasses, and live-verified statistic/detail selector constants (statisticType/periodType). No register, wire-encoding or write-validation changes.

WebSocket writes (Phase 4 slice 1): set_system_mode (home/save, Modbus-compatible numbering, validated 0-5), acknowledge_all_notifications / acknowledge_notification (notification/save), read_home_overview (systemMode state), all with capture-confirmed success/danger note semantics. Explicit opt-in methods; the client stays read-only unless called.

WebSocket writes slice 3: read_heatingcircuit (full circuit state incl. mode chooselist, normal/eco room setpoints with device-declared ranges, room temperature, pump, available circuits) and save_heatingcircuit_parameter (system.heatingcircuit/save, range-validated).
Additive: IdmWebHeatingCircuit.flow_setpoint (temperatures.set).
Navigator 2.0 statistics pages (runtime/generated heat/electrical energy as normalized totals) and set_datetime on both web clients (Nav2 HTTP PUT SSETDATETIME, Nav10 setting/save 4537).

Navigator 10 system controllers: performance detail (live power figures), controller-side weather forecast, iON status (read-only) and energyflow (grid/PV; house channel removed in firmware 20.24-1580).
Fixture scrub: documentation addresses instead of live plant values in tests and tool examples.
Navigator 1.x coil rework (idm-heatpump-hass #319): c3003 Vorrangladung becomes a write-only command, momentary demand coils c3001/c3002 leave the map.
Complete-plant system/overview read (buffer, energyflow, freshwater, heatpump, heating circuits with regulation type) - the level-0 source for heating-circuit-type detection (idm-heatpump-hass #429).
Logging-only patch: a persistently invalid register value warns once per episode instead of on every poll (idm-heatpump-hass #460).
Register-data fix: dhw_charge_off_temp validation range 46..53 -> 46..67 per live evidence in idm-heatpump-hass #460.
Register-data fix: not-present fills declared as sentinels (bivalence_state/solar_mode 255, cooling setpoints and ext_demand temps 0) per Navigator 2.0 diagnostics in idm-heatpump-hass #532.
Register-data fix: heat_sink_flow_rate (1072) re-typed UCHAR -> word-swapped FLOAT32 per field evidence in idm-heatpump-hass discussion #516.

Holiday system mode (3) accepted by validated shared-family Modbus polls; 180 integration contract/platform/reference checks passed against the fix source. Integration prerelease validation and field confirmation are separate.

Prerelease hardening: model-detection heating-circuit probes batched behind individual gates (14 to 4 round trips, per-slot fallback preserved, gate slots keep the Navigator 1.7 signature shape); write-plan labeling, shared timeout and error-mapping helpers, and expanded key-API (set_value/read_value) and Pymodbus coil-extension test coverage. No register-map changes; 3149 integration contract tests passed against this tree.

Stable promotion of the 2.14.5b1/b2 hardening (Holiday system mode accepted in validated shared-family polls; model-detection heating-circuit probes batched 14 to 4 round trips with per-slot fallback) plus the Navigator 10 intermediate-circuit pump signal mapped from M125 with M124 kept as an alias (#151). The 0.23.2 integration line (b1-b5) passed its full suite against this tree.

Optional connects_lazily transport attribute for shared-hold transports (Home Assistant 2026.10+ modbus.async_get_unit): connect() acquires a claim, the first request opens the wire, close() releases the claim without disturbing other holders. The client connected-gate honours the attribute; transports without it keep the pre-2.15 behaviour. Consumer: the integration's shared Modbus connection provider.

Navigator 2.0 structured JSON temperatures and version-2 nested statistics supported alongside legacy responses. 113 integration web and cross-repository contract tests passed against this API source; full consumer pin validation runs separately. Synthetic fixtures contain no private submission data. No Modbus/write changes.

Navigator 10/2.0 changeover valve (1110) carries the officially documented Heating/Cooling enum and the heat-source circuit fault (1680) becomes a binary register with its documented inverted polarity, both from the value-list audit that followed the Holiday gap. Unmapped read values keep the not-in-enum rejection; undocumented 0/1 neighbours stay raw pending field captures. Read-validation behaviour changes for the two registers only.

Changeover valve 1110 declares the UINT16 not-configured sentinel 65535 so plants without the heating/cooling function pass validated polls after the 2.16.0 enum landed. First field report against 2.16.0b1; no other register changes.
